key_insight: OrbitTAMP grounds language-model intent in a hierarchical task-and-motion planning stack so spacecraft rendezvous plans stay physically valid while still accepting natural-language commands.
engineering_relevance: This offers a scalable, auditable interface for spacecraft RPO mission planning that can reduce expert translation effort and improve operational consistency.
method: LLM converts a command into a partial mission specification.
Planning modules fill in missing decisions using admissible spacecraft behaviors and constraints.
Trajectory optimization turns the completed spec into a dynamically feasible trajectory.
evidence_signal: Across evaluated splits, frontier LLMs achieved 98% exact recovery of partial mission specifications, and a 9B model improved from 75% to 88% with verifier-guided revision.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the behavior graph, planners, and verification loop, so incomplete domain modeling could still lead to invalid or suboptimal plans.
paper_title: OrbitTAMP: Grounding Language Models for Task and Motion Planning in Spacecraft Rendezvous
